Hello and welcome!

I’m a Ph.D. student in the Department of Statistics at Penn State University. I received my B.S. in Mathematics with a concentration in Data Science from the University of California, Irvine in 2024. My current research areas focus on latent variable modeling with application to behavioral data and statistics/data science education.

**Email:** exc5589[at]psu[dot]edu
